deployments_detail.use: Defense sovereign-AI ecosystem (11 MOUs incl. SNU/KAIST/POSTECH/Naver Cloud); targeting C4I/autonomous defense platforms

Sovereign defense AI foundation model for next-generation battlefield situational awareness — real-time threat analysis/identification, AI-assisted command decisions, and optimal weapon-system selection for air defense operations. Built to reduce reliance on foreign AI and prevent confidential data leaks. [Naver Cloud; Seoul National University; POSTECH; Northrop Grumman (partners)]

AI-based redevelopment of the Allied Korea Joint Command and Control System (AKJCCS) for Korea-US combined operations — AI situational analysis and automated decision-making support on cloud infrastructure. Described as Korea's first application of AI to a command-and-control system.

AI-powered naval Combat Management System (Naval Shield CMS) unveiled at MADEX 2025 — AI automation for threat evaluation and weapon assignment aboard ROK Navy warships, including a next-gen reduced-manning 'Smart Battleship' concept.
AI/big-data-based automatic naval mine detection and mine-warfare mission planning combat system for South Korean Navy minesweepers — real-time identification of underwater objects.

30-ton AI-powered unmanned surface vessel (USV) launched for sea trials to validate AI-based autonomous navigation, target recognition, and open (US Navy UMAA-aligned) software architecture; testbed running through end of 2027.

AI integration into SAR satellite platform — high-resolution satellite imagery analyzed in near real time by the company's AI systems for rapid detection of ground features/changes; part of a plan to operate 64 SAR satellites by 2031.

Next-generation Active Protection System (NG-APS) for main battle tanks/combat vehicles integrating an expanded sensor array with AI processing and analysis to detect, track, and intercept incoming anti-tank threats.
AI integration with satellite imagery for earth observation
AI-powered Combat Management System (CMS) for naval vessels
AI-powered Integrated Bridge System for naval operations
AI integration with SAR satellite systems
AI deployment in finance, video surveillance, aerospace, and energy operations

AgentOne enterprise AI agent platform (ICT Division) — commercial platform with pre-built agents, AI governance, custom agent-creation tools, and a Vision-to-Agentic pipeline (vision recognition to LLM reasoning to autonomous action) tailored for manufacturing, defense, and service-industry office/back-office automation.
AI-powered surveillance for logistics efficiency and security monitoring

Special-purpose drone surveillance radar using composite sensors and big-data-driven AI to detect small unmanned aircraft and both metal and non-metal mines — described as Korea's first AI-applied radar of this type.
Counter-UAS (anti-drone) defense system combining radar detection with high-powered laser interception; domestic contracts including ~33 mobile counter-drone systems mounted on military vehicles.
AI camera analytics for physical security and vehicle safety [Ambarella]
AI-powered video surveillance for retail and public spaces with analytics
